name: Viking® Tuscany 66" Antique Bronze Pro Style Dual Fuel Range with 2 Induction
shortDescription: The Viking® Tuscany Antique Bronze 66" Dual Fuel Range combines timeless style with exceptional cooking performance. Its antique bronze finish adds sophistication, while the powerful gas burners and precise electric ovens provide unmatched heat control, perfect for both everyday and gourmet cooking.
metaDescription: High performance burners provide fast boil times and a gentle simmer. 20,000 BTU – 8,500 BTU high burner ratings. Stainless steel burner pan. Electronic single point spark ignition/re-ignition on all burners. Porcelain coated cast iron burner grates. Optional surface configurations.
